payload.name: five-code threat taxonomy
payload.instrument_method: coding instrument for classifying observed failures

{"method": "The framework contributes a five-code threat taxonomy (T1 through T5), designed as a 
coding instrument for classifying observed failures, each code mapping to the classical 
validity type it primarily compromises; six monitorable indicators with a four-level severity 
scale and a reproducibility checklist; and a crosswalk connecting SFV to NIST AI Risk Man-
agement Framework requirements for test, evaluation, verification, and validation (TEVV) 
and to Federal Committee on Statistical Methodology (FCSM) data quality standards."}

payload.grounding_text:
Bhardwaj’s Agent Behavioral Contracts (Bhardwaj 2026) provide the formal machinery that SFV’s 
operationalization section gestures toward but does not develop: if you can specify invariants 
and measure a recovery rate, you can bound expected drift.

payload.grounding_text:

adds median less than 50 microseconds of overhead per turn (Rafique and Bindschaedler 2026), 
establishing that the engineering cost of enforcement is negligible relative to the inferential cost 
of undetected state loss.

4 State Fidelity Validity: Definition and Decom-
position
State Fidelity Validity (SFV) is the degree to which an AI-assisted research or analytic pipeline 
preserves the accuracy and integrity of its accumulated internal state across sequential operations, 
such that inferences at step N remain warranted by the actual history of steps 1 through N-1, 
rather than by degraded, distorted, confabulated, or selectively retained versions of that history.

payload.subject: webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity
payload.grounding_text:
4 State Fidelity Validity: Definition and Decom-
position
State Fidelity Validity (SFV) is the degree to which an AI-assisted research or analytic pipeline 
preserves the accuracy and integrity of its accumulated internal state across sequential operations, 
such that inferences at step N remain warranted by the actual history of steps 1 through N-1, 
rather than by degraded, distorted, confabulated, or selectively retained versions of that history.

Good data management is not a goal in itself, but rather is the key conduit leading to knowledge
discovery and innovation, and to subsequent data and knowledge integration and reuse by the
community after the data publication process.

speciﬁc technology, standard, or implementation-solution; moreover, the Principles are not,
themselves, a standard or a speci ﬁcation.

(‘I2’).

payload.subject: wilkinson-2016-fair-guiding-principles
payload.grounding_text:
FAIRness is a prerequisite for proper data management and data stewardship
The ideas within the FAIR Guiding Principles re ﬂect, combine, build upon and extend previous work by
both the Concept Web Alliance (https://conceptweblog.wordpress.com/) partners, who focused on
machine-actionability and harmonization of data structures and semantics, and by the scienti ﬁc and
scholarly organizations that developed the Joint Declaration of Data Citation Principles (JDDCP 29),
Box 3 | Emergent community/collaborative initiatives with FAIR as a core focus or activity
bioCADDIE (https://biocaddie.org): The NIH BD 2K biomedical and healthCAre Data Discovery Index Ecosystem (bioCADDIE) consortium works to develop a
Data Discovery Index (DDI) prototype, which is set to be as transformative and impactful for data as PubMed for the biomedical literature 30.

FAIRness is a prerequisite for proper data management and data stewardship
The ideas within the FAIR Guiding Principles re ﬂect, combine, build upon and extend previous work by
both the Concept Web Alliance (https://conceptweblog.wordpress.com/) partners, who focused on
machine-actionability and harmonization of data structures and semantics, and by the scienti ﬁc and
scholarly organizations that developed the Joint Declaration of Data Citation Principles (JDDCP 29),
Box 3 | Emergent community/collaborative initiatives with FAIR as a core focus or activity
bioCADDIE (https://biocaddie.org): The NIH BD 2K biomedical and healthCAre Data Discovery Index Ecosystem (bioCADDIE) consortium works to develop a
Data Discovery Index (DDI) prototype, which is set to be as transformative and impactful for data as PubMed for the biomedical literature 30.

numbers, sums of money, etc.) in a beam-

those summaries whose quantity terms are sup-
ported by the original text.
